correctness.rationale: The deficiency is Δ=pq-3p-3q-3. Since Δ<pq, only six small proper divisors can appear. Each of the 20 triples has sum c+ap+bq and rearranges to (p-(b+3))(q-(a+3))=(a+3)(b+3)+c+3, with the constant at most 33; its positive divisors give exactly six prime pairs. Fresh brute force below 100 reproduces the list and the frozen verifier checks all twenty rows and each witness.
